profile.headline: Engineering @ Bubble
profile.summary: I spent 10 years running music schools before pivoting to tech. I've worked all sorts of different roles, from customer support, to product development, and now working as a Software Engineer building visual development products with AI.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description: Working on Bubble's AI team to help bring AI to the Bubble editor

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description: Working on Bubble's AI team to help bring AI to the Bubble editor

positions.title: Senior Bubble Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description: Responsible for product development and technical direction of larger feature builds for Bubble's logged out marketing site and logged in account management screens.

positions.title: Co-Owner
positions.description: I am the co-owner of a hi-tech music education company called So i Heard Music.  We teach kids music using recording software and iPad apps to improve their motivation and willingness to practice.   We have two locations - one in Millburn, NJ and one in Gillette, NJ.   I am passionate about finding new ways to incorporate technology into education in all areas and fields.

positions.title: Piano & Guitar Teacher
positions.description: Lessons available on Guitar, Piano, and private tutoring in Music Theory.
